description: This PHP file defines the class ADODB_pdo_sqlite, which implements a database driver for SQLite using PDO within the ADOdb abstraction layer. It includes methods for server info retrieval, SQL limit adjustment, sequence generation, transaction control, and schema introspection specific to SQLite.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_sqlite
classes.description: A driver class for SQLite database operations using PDO, providing methods for querying, sequence management, transactions, and schema metadata.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the driver with the parent PDO driver, configuring input array binding and transaction support.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves and returns server version, encoding information of the SQLite database.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Appends LIMIT and OFFSET to a SQL query for paginated result sets.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier using a sequence table or row in SQLite.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence table in the database to manage sequential IDs.

methods.name: SetTransactionMode
methods.description: Sets the transaction mode for subsequent transaction commands.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a new transaction if transactions are supported.

methods.name: CommitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if one is active.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction if one is active.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Fetches column metadata for a specified table, returning detailed schema info.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Lists table names in the database, optionally filtered by a mask.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Provides driver-specific format for bind parameters, returning placeholders for PDO.
